tested_builder: bs4.builder._lxml.LXMLTreeBuilderForXML (builder_registry.lookup('xml'); asserted in the image and in run-control.py)
parser_family: Beautiful Soup tree builder over lxml.etree XMLParser(target=..., recover=True) over libxml2 2.15.4; shares the lxml/libxml2 XML parser family with projects/xml/python/lxml and has no independent XML tokenizer
build_note: bs4 is installed from the pinned py3-none-any wheel (bs4/ checked byte-identical to the sdist). lxml is built from its pinned sdist without Cython regeneration and linked dynamically to libxml2 2.15.4 built from source with clang LLVM source coverage, the same pins as projects/xml/python/lxml. lxml's own Cython/C binding is not coverage-instrumented. Official lxml wheels bundle their own static libxml2 build; linkage differs from the shipped wheel.
api: bs4.BeautifulSoup(local XML bytes, "xml"); Tag.namespace, Tag.name, NamespacedAttribute.namespace/name, NavigableString, Comment and XMLProcessingInstruction children of the resulting bs4 tree
fuzz_engine: external one-file Python bridge for AFL++ and generator replay
coverage: Python line tracing of the installed bs4 package during parsing (builder/_lxml.py, element.py and tree construction) plus LLVM source coverage of source-built libxml2 2.15.4 parser.c reached through lxml.etree
scope: Valid UTF-8 XML 1.0 local byte streams without DOCTYPE through BeautifulSoup(bytes, 'xml'): namespace-expanded element and attribute names, namespace declarations, decoded character data in document order, comments, processing instructions and tree depth from the bs4 tree. bs4 does not keep CDATA section boundaries (CDATA becomes a NavigableString), does not keep the XML declaration as a node, and stores namespace declarations as xmlns attributes after ordinary attributes rather than in source order.
parser_options_caveat: bs4 creates lxml.etree.XMLParser(target=builder, recover=True, huge_tree=False, encoding=<EncodingDetector guess>); recover=True makes this path lenient where projects/xml/python/lxml uses recover=False. No malformed-input behavior was tested.
coverage_caveat: libxml2 parser.c lines 8700-8720 (an address-sensitive attribute hash lookup) vary between identical replays: the order control's parser.c line total ranged 1,718-1,727 across repeats, differing only at lines 8705, 8714 and 8716. The AFL++ bridge excludes that range, as in projects/xml/python/lxml. lxml's Cython/C binding is not coverage-instrumented.
